observable: Screw loosening rate in dental implants after 6 months of use
conditions: Implants with the inventive device will be compared to implants with the standard interface in a controlled clinical trial with 100 participants, and the results will be analyzed after 6 months of use.
falsifier: If the inventive device does not show a statistically significant reduction in screw loosening rate compared to the standard interface, or if the reduction is less than 20%.
